entries.name: TP Potion Small
entries.description: Tests a small heal: restores a tenth of a creature's HP.

entries.name: TP Potion Full
entries.description: Tests a full heal: restores all of a creature's HP.

entries.name: TP Potion Zero
entries.description: Tests a heal of fraction 0, the schema minimum, which does nothing.

entries.name: TP Energy Small
entries.description: Tests a partial energy restore: gives back a quarter of a creature's energy.

entries.name: TP Full Restore
entries.description: Tests a full cure: heals all HP, restores all energy and cures any status.

entries.name: TP Battle Boost
entries.description: Tests a battle-category item: raises one ally's Speed by 3 stages.

entries.name: TP Antidote
entries.description: Tests a filtered cure_status: cures Burn and nothing else.

entries.name: TP Cure All
entries.description: Tests an unfiltered cure_status: cures whatever status the creature has.
